flavor.phonemic_palette: Ge'ez/South-Semitic backbone (emphatics t'/s'/q'; gutturals h/h./kh/'; -a endings; triconsonantal roots) with Akkadian overlay touches (-u/-tu endings on some names, mar-filiation); theophoric stems are second-order morphs of the Punic forms (Talrish-, Arganu-, Warlanu-, Riyalat-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Mesopotamian + Ethiopian per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Mesopotamian + Ethiopian register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'sabaean'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Sabaean — tolerant theocratic of the desert; wealth, piety.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Sabaean (Mesopotamian + Ethiopian) are a defensive theocratic people seeded in desert, mountains. They prize wealth, piety, tradition, lean toward the mercantile sphere, and field light_cavalry, archers, heavy_infantry. Outsiders are met as tolerant; their patrons touch trade, harvest, night.
